title: Look at the Output Type
text: The desired output is a list containing every emoji name found in the comment, not just the first match.

title: Function That Returns All Matches
text: Which re function returns a list of all non-overlapping matches in a string?

title: Use the Capturing Group with findall
text: re.findall returns all matches. When the pattern has one capturing group, it returns the text captured by that group for each match, which gives open\_mouth and camera.
